_instructions: This template does not claim that the example column names are official SoftPharm names.
Replace every columns value with the exact heading in the pharmacy's real SoftPharm CSV export.
Set PHARMALINK_SECRET in the Windows environment; do not add the secret to this file.
Keep aggregate_duplicate_codes enabled when the export contains one row per batch or expiry.
Set safety.minimum_rows below the pharmacy's normal unique-product count, but above any plausible partial export.
